reviews.comment: Dr. Poirot's class was definitely a fun one. Great teacher, and I learned a lot about public speaking. She makes her criteria for speeches very clear. Even if you aren't the best at public speaking, as long as you put in the effort and apply feedback to each speech, you will definitely grow in your public speaking abilities and get better grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Poirot was amazing! I took Honors Public Speaking, a service-learning based class, and had the best time.
